entry_points.summary: Top-level CLI entry: dispatches to cmd_inspect, cmd_wizard, cmd_apply, cmd_explain, or cmd_status
Inspect subcommand: delegates to --json, --flat, or grouped view; always read-only
Machine-parseable JSON of all resolved config keys with source, strength, persistence_class
Flat key=value with source column (git-config style); --flat flag
Default concern-grouped inspect view; 8 sections: notifications, workflow, overnight, providers, personas, docs, memories, axioms
Guided concern-grouped wizard; --scope limits to one section; emits wizard_section_start/end events
One-shot posture-preset bootstrap; computes diff, confirms, writes via config.py set; emits setup_apply_done
Heuristic posture detection: returns preset name, 'none', or 'custom'; used by cmd_status
Compact one-line status: posture, providers bound/none, docs initialized/missing, routing-prefs count
Core read helper: subprocess calls config.py inspect-all --json; returns parsed dict or None on failure
Hardcoded dict: posture name -> {toml: {key:val}, env: {VAR:val}}; three presets: interactive, overnight, ci-batch
Diff between posture target and current effective config; returns will_change, unchanged, env_to_emit
Axioms wizard section: configure axioms.* TOML keys, install kernel-pointer in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, add .gitignore entries
Idempotently install canonical kernel-pointer marker block into CLAUDE.md; diff on mismatch; collapses duplicate blocks
Idempotently add one entry to .gitignore; returns added|already_present|error:<msg>
Thin bash wrapper: exec python3 setup.py $@
Skill surface: parses inspect/wizard/apply/explain/status forms, delegates to scripts/setup.py, gates apply with AskUserQuestion, and emits setup_skill_start/end.

invariants: setup.py never writes TOML directly; all TOML writes delegate to config.py set via subprocess
cmd_inspect, _cmd_inspect_json, _cmd_inspect_flat, _cmd_inspect_grouped are READ-ONLY: no file writes of any kind
Memories are never written by setup.py; edits route exclusively to /z-suggest-memory
Wizard always shows current effective state before any prompt — no blind first-run overwrite without user consent
POSTURE_PRESETS is a hardcoded constant; adding a preset requires a code change to setup.py
/z-setup skill shells out to setup.py; it never reimplements config logic inline
Env-only knobs are surfaced read-only in inspect; they are configured via shell snippet output, never written to TOML
Re-run is idempotent: diff-and-confirm always shown before any write; silent overwrite is forbidden
apply --dry-run exits 0 after printing diff with no writes
Wizard --scope values are matched lowercase; a capitalized scope name fails with exit code 2
_install_kernel_pointer is idempotent: no-op when block matches canonical; user-confirmed overwrite when block differs; collapses multiple marker blocks to one
gotchas: _inspect_all_json delegates to config.py inspect-all via subprocess; if config.py unavailable, returns None and subcommands fail gracefully
Wizard providers and docs sections are suggest-only: detect gaps and print tip, do NOT invoke /z-providers-discover or /z-init-docs
Memories wizard section is read-only display; use /z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference to add or edit
POSTURE_PRESETS env vars are emitted as shell snippet to stdout or --env-file; they are never written to any config file
apply --yes skips confirmation prompt; use only where user consent is established upstream
Overnight posture sets Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt for the shell session; mutually exclusive with Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1
cmd_explain is a pure pass-through to config.py explain; adds no logic
_detect_posture is heuristic: partial preset match returns 'custom', not the preset name; not authoritative
_wizard_axioms kernel-pointer targets ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (global user file); does NOT touch per-repo CLAUDE.md

Axioms wizard scope surfaces Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_ENABLED, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_KERNEL_BUDGET_CHARS, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_EXTRACT_MIN_RECURRENCE, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_AUTO_EXTRACT_POST_RUN — these are NOT in the core ENV_ONLY_KNOBS list in config.py
Wizard now has 8 scopes: notifications, workflow, overnight, providers, personas, docs, memories, axioms

event_vocabulary.description: Emitted at the start of every setup.py invocation before subcommand dispatch
Emitted after a successful apply write; includes posture name, TOML key count, env var count, and scope
Emitted at the start of each wizard section
Emitted at the end of each wizard section after prompts and optional writes
Emitted after the wizard final-review section writes accumulated changes
Emitted by /z-setup skill at invocation start, before any subprocess
Emitted by /z-setup skill after all invocation-form logic including error paths
